# The composition ladder

The [composition model](composition.md) lists eight rungs, from ordinary props to a
documentation recipe. A family offers the *smallest sufficient* seam — not all eight, and
not a headless hook where a prop would do.

The rungs are ordinary props; controlled state and callbacks when state exists; accessors;
named slots; render props; exported parts; headless hooks; and complete recipes. Passive
families may stop at the first rung. Interaction features normally expose several.

This table is derived from what each family declares, so it cannot describe a seam that
was removed or miss one that was added. The table focuses on feature families, where the
higher rungs are meaningful; the columns start at accessors.

## The four the plan names

Global Search, Filters, Comments and Data View are the demonstration cases, because a
ladder that only works on a Badge proves nothing. Each is usable at three heights:

### `features/global-search`

**Ready-made** — `GlobalSearch`, dropped in with props and callbacks.

**Region-customized** — 8 exported parts, so a region can be replaced without copying the whole: `GlobalSearchDialog`, `GlobalSearchEmptyState`, `GlobalSearchFooter`, `GlobalSearchIdleState`, `GlobalSearchInput`, and 2 more.

**Headless** — `useGlobalSearch`, for presentation the parts cannot express.

### `features/filters`

**Ready-made** — `FilterLayout`, dropped in with props and callbacks.

**Region-customized** — 18 exported parts, so a region can be replaced without copying the whole: `AsyncFilterEditor`, `DateFilterEditor`, `FilterEditor`, `FilterErrorBoundary`, `FilterOperator`, and 12 more.

**Headless** — `useAsyncOptions`, `useFilterCache`, `useFilterGroups`, `useFilters`, for presentation the parts cannot express.

### `features/comments`

**Ready-made** — `Comments`, dropped in with props and callbacks.

**Region-customized** — 6 exported parts, so a region can be replaced without copying the whole: `CommentAttachmentChip`, `CommentComposer`, `CommentContent`, `CommentItem`, `CommentTimeline`.

**Headless** — `useAttachmentUpload`, `useComments`, for presentation the parts cannot express.

### `features/data-view`

**Ready-made** — `DataView`, dropped in with props and callbacks.

**Region-customized** — 6 exported parts, so a region can be replaced without copying the whole: `DataViewPagination`, `DataViewShell`, `DataViewTableFrame`, `DataViewToolbar`, `SavedViewTabs`.

**Headless** — `useDataView`, for presentation the parts cannot express.
